notes.title: V3.1 - Xbox Controller Support!! And Vibration!!
notes.notes:
We have added the ability to use an Xbox Controller to navigate menus using the left joystick, D-pad, and the A and B Keys. 
We also added vibrations for shooting and jumping with the Xbox Controller. Enjoy!!

notes.title: Major Update: 240 Levels: 120 Levels with Power Ups
notes.notes:
Hi Incredifall Players!!
A major update with a total of 240 Levels!
120 Levels have Power Ups: special abilities that enhance gameplay!
To play the Power Up Levels, go to Level Select and play Level 121 onwards.
Enjoy!

notes.title: V2.0 MASSIVE UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Shooting and Movement is twice as quick - faster gameplay
Bullets now last for a 30-second duration
120 Levels! Up from 65
Enjoy!

Huge variety of levels including Falling: 747s, Bones, Grenades, More Cars, AK-47s, planets, and so much more! 

The only way to try it is to start playing the game and unlocking the levels.
